_about: Hand-maintained per-set rules that are not in the game data files (they live in game scripts). Shop odds, pool sizes, roster and unlocks are generated by tools/build_static.py instead. For a new set: copy the previous entry, then check every value against that set's first patch notes.

_sources.xp_to_next_level: Research notes (economy_tempo.md): level 8 cost 56 per Riot 18.2 as reported by TFTSense; not read directly in patch notes. Level 10->11 only via Set 19 scroll (999 XP per Inven).
_sources.streak_gold: UNRESOLVED: TFTips (Set 18) pays +1 from a 2-streak; TFT Ninja and MetaTFT from 3. Riot moved it in 14.1 and 14.8.
_sources.stage_damage: Riot 14.8, 14.9 and 16.1 patch notes (16.1 raised stage 3 to 6, cut stage 4 to 7).
_sources.interest: Evergreen; TFTips and LUM.GG Set 18 specs.
